_doc: Per-embodiment action layouts of the Doppel models. Every action is a (17, D) array of per-frame STATES (not deltas), frame-aligned with the 17 video frames of a clip (frame 0 = the conditioning image). Inference z-scores it with assets/action_stats/<robot_type>.json, sets slots with dof_mask 0 to exactly 0, and (for the 8-embodiment model) zero-extends it to 159 slots. Rotations of SMPL-X/H are axis-angle; their root slots 0-2 are unwrapped per clip before the z-score. 'fps' is the native frame rate of the source video; training clips sample 17 frames from it (see README, data format).

layout: global orientation, axis-angle, camera frame (unwrapped per clip)
15 left-hand joints x 3, axis-angle (MANO order: index, middle, pinky, ring, thumb)
smplx_human.dof_mask: 42 slots = 0: the 8 lower-body joints (hips, knees, ankles, feet) and the finger PIP/DIP y axes plus index-DIP x per hand (constant in the OakInk2 fits); see doppel.data_multi._smplx_human_dof_mask

layout: left wrist orientation, first two columns of the camera-frame rotation matrix (r00 r10 r20 r01 r11 r21)
15 left finger joints x 3, local axis-angle, full rotations (MANO order: index, middle, pinky, ring, thumb)

smplh_human.layout: same 159-D layout as smplx_human (SMPL-H body + hands)
